name: Teaching Dimension / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: Every globally identifying teaching map is no-clashing.
proof: For each $h\in\mathcal H$, choose a teaching set $T(h)$ of size at most $\mathrm{TD}(\mathcal H)$. If $h\ne h'$, then $T(h)$ is inconsistent with $h'$ because it identifies $h$ uniquely in the whole class. Thus no pair can clash, and the same map witnesses $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{TD}(\mathcal H)$.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Proposition prop:td-low-nctd.
witness_verification: For the $n$ singletons together with the empty concept, teaching dimension is $n$ while no-clashing teaching dimension is 1.
